Package index

Classical Area-Level Models (EBLUP)

High-performance C++ implementation of Fay-Herriot models

eblup_fh()
Empirical Best Linear Unbiased Prediction based on a Fay-Herriot Model.
eblup_sfh()
Empirical Best Linear Unbiased Prediction based on a Spatial Fay-Herriot Model.
eblup_stfh()
Empirical Best Linear Unbiased Prediction based on a Spatio-Temporal Fay-Herriot Model.

Bayesian Area-Level Models (INLA / EBP)

Hierarchical Bayesian Small Area Estimation using INLA across 6 distributions with spatial and spatio-temporal effects

ebp_area()
Empirical Best Prediction for Area-Level Small Area Estimation

Unit-Level Models

Battese-Harter-Fuller model for unit-level survey data

eblup_bhf()
Empirical Best Linear Unbiased Prediction (EBLUP) for the Battese-Harter-Fuller Model

Model Diagnostics & Visualization

Universal diagnostic framework and ggplot2 visualization methods

diagnose()
Diagnostic Evaluation of Small Area Estimation Models
autoplot(<fastsae_diagnose>)
Autoplot Method for fastsae_diagnose Objects
autoplot(<fastsae>) autoplot(<list>)
Autoplot Method for fastsae Objects
summary(<fastsae>)
Summarize a fastsae object
coef(<fastsae>)
Extract coefficients from a fastsae object
fitted(<fastsae>)
Extract fitted values (EBLUP or EBP) from a fastsae object
residuals(<fastsae>)
Extract residuals from a fastsae object
print(<fastsae>)
Print a fastsae object
print(<summary.fastsae>)
Print summary of a fastsae object

Simulation & Synthetic Data Generation

Utilities to simulate area-level cross-sectional, panel, and spatial weight matrices

sim_area_data()
Simulate Multi-Distribution Small Area Data with Spatial Autocorrelation
sim_series_data()
Simulate Spatio-Temporal Multi-Distribution Small Area Data
sim_spatial_weights()
Simulate Spatial Proximity and Adjacency Matrices
